meta.title: How Finnish ad sites format car, flat-for-sale and rental ads, plus 12 synthetic test ads for the rule-based reader
meta.method: Public listing and ad pages were opened without logging in: plain HTTP download for Autotalli, Etuovi, Oikotie and Vuokraovi, and a normal browser for Nettiauto (it answers plain HTTP clients with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' page). Labels were read from the rendered page text. About 30 pages were examined in all.
meta.privacy: No names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses or street addresses were collected. Real ads show agent, property-manager and private-seller contact details. A reader must skip them. In the test ads, streets are placeholders (Esimerkkikatu, Esimerkkitie, Esimerkkikuja), plates are placeholders (ABC-123) and sellers are generic.
meta.sourceStatus: Site labels, value formats and quirks are primary observations from the sites on the date above. All test ads are synthetic: their prices, kilometres and fees are plausible values made up for testing and are NOT market data. Wherever a test uses a label that was not seen on the site, its 'assumptions' field says so.

fieldKeys.note: Proposed normalized keys for the reader's output. Rename freely; this is a proposal, not a decision.
fieldKeys.money: EUR as a number (no thousands separators, decimal point). Per-month charges are EUR/month unless 'per' says otherwise.
fieldKeys.dates: ISO: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the ad gives only month and year. 'available' may also be 'now'.
fieldKeys.missing: null means the ad does not state it. The reader should not guess.

factCheck.method: Re-opened the source pages live: plain HTTP for Etuovi, Oikotie, Vuokraovi and Autotalli; a browser for Nettiauto (plain HTTP got HTTP 403 'Just a moment...' again); Finlex for the energy-certificate act.

thousandsSeparator.rule: A space of some kind. Accept U+0020, U+00A0 (no-break space) and U+202F/U+2009 (narrow and thin spaces) between digit groups. Some fields use no separator at all.
observed: Etuovi, Oikotie: U+00A0 between digit groups in prices and charges ('298 000 €'; Etuovi plot size '3 140 m²'), and U+00A0 or U+0020 before '€'. Oikotie's plot area uses U+0020 between groups ('Tontin pinta-ala 1 675 m²') (fact-check 2026-10-17).
Autotalli: U+00A0 in the header ('37 900 €', '52 000 km') but NO separator in the Perustiedot table ('37900 €', '52000 km')

Nettiauto search-result cards: U+0020 between groups and U+00A0 before '€' ('13 990 €'). On the ad page itself (header and Perustiedot) both are U+0020 ('16 390 €', '158 000 km'), and the dealer's other-ads cards on the same page print prices with no separator ('9940 €') (fact-check 2026-10-17, DOM text of nettiauto.com/volkswagen/golf and /volkswagen/golf/15930032).
Vuokraovi: '1 020 € / kk' in one field and '1020 €' (no separator) in Vakuus on the same ad
thousandsSeparator.note: Copy-paste may or may not keep U+00A0. It depends on the browser and OS, so do not rely on it.

decimalMark.rule: Finnish UI uses a decimal comma ('59,5 m²', '238,00 € / kk'). Some fields use a decimal point even in Finnish UI, and English UIs switch to a point.
observed: Nettiauto English UI: 'Engine 1.5 l, Petrol', 'offer 260.94 €/m' (Finnish UI: '1,5 l, Bensiini', 'alk. 260,94 €/kk')
English free text written by people may use '€1,234.56' (comma = thousands). This is the general English convention, not something seen on these sites (fact-check 2026-10-17).

currency: English: sign before the number, as in the Nettiauto English UI boilerplate 'Price from €2.90'. '€640/month' is an illustrative free-text example, not an observed ad (fact-check 2026-10-17).
periods: '€ / hlö / kk', '€/hlö/kk', '€/kk/hlö', 'e/kk/henkilö' = per person per month
English UI: '€ / month', '€/month', '€ / person / month'; Nettiauto EN '€/m' = per month
area: Etuovi header 'Koko 59,5 / 90 m²' = living area / total area
Oikotie 'Tontin pinta-ala' and 'Tontin koko' are plot sizes, not the flat
floor: Etuovi 'Kerrokset 2/3', Oikotie 'Kerros 1 / 7', Vuokraovi 'Kerros 2/7' = floor / floors in building; sometimes only '3'

roomWords.note: Finnish room counts include the living room. Vuokraovi English shows Kaksio as '1 bedroom', so rooms = bedrooms + 1. An English '2-bedroom apartment' is a Finnish kolmio.

layoutAbbreviations.Yh: 2h+kk: layout as written in the housing company's articles (Oikotie)

energyClass: letter = class, year = scale (2013 or 2018). 'Ei lain edellyttämää energiatodistusta' means the ad gives no energy class (energyClass null). It does NOT mean the building is exempt. Vuokraovi's English UI renders it 'Legally required energy certificate not available', Etuovi's UI-string key for it is 'energyCertificate.NOT_AVAILABLE', and it was seen on a 2023 block of flats, which needed a certificate already for its building permit (Laki rakennuksen energiatodistuksesta 50/2013, 5 §). Public sale and rental ads must state the class except in the cases of 6 § 2 mom (sale within a group, sale for demolition, fixed-term rental of at most one year, subletting). Sources: https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2013/50 (6 § 'Energiatodistus myynti- ja vuokraustilanteissa'), vuokraovi.com/kohde/ct8278 and /en/item/ct8278, etuovi.com/kohde/59008973 page HTML (fact-check 2026-10-17). Corrected from 'no certificate required'.
renovationLines: Oikotie: '2022 Vesijohto- ja sähkösaneeraus'; planned items may carry year ranges and a long-term-plan (PTS) code: '2027 - 2031 2.5.1.1 - Hissit: Hissien peruskorjaus'

Pipe-renovation words to look for: putkiremontti, linjasaneeraus, LVIS-saneeraus, LVI-saneeraus, käyttövesiputket, viemärit, 'Putkiremontoitu' (an Etuovi search keyword). Relining words ('viemäripinnoitus', 'sukitus') mean pipes were coated, not replaced.
copyPasteShape: Copying a whole page gives one label per line with its value on the next line. Section headings sit between them.
The same value often appears twice: once in the summary at the top and again in the details.
An empty field is followed straight away by the next label or section heading (Autotalli 'Viimeisin huolto' followed by 'Lisätiedot'). Do not take a heading as the value.

A subscript splits a label across lines: Autotalli 'CO
2
päästöt'.
Every page carries boilerplate with numbers: financing offers, insurance price estimates and history-check prices ('Hinta alkaen 2,90 €'). None of these are ad values.

notes: Ad page header, top to bottom: make + model, price, [old price when reduced], variant text, 'alk. X €/kk' financing, 'Päivitetty dd.mm.yyyy', 'City, Region', 'ID n', then chips: fuel, year, km, gearbox. The variant text and the financing line can swap places: one ad read '600 €', '800 €', 'alk. 12,16 €/kk', 'T25', 'Ei tieliikennekelpoinen' (fact-check 2026-10-17).
A reduced price shows two prices one after the other ('600 €' then '800 €'). The first is the current price and the second is the struck-through old price.
Search result card: make + model / price / 'alk. X €/kk' / '<engine litres>, <variant>' / 'year ● km ● fuel ● gearbox ● drive' / free text / 'City, seller'.

The variant text can carry flags and promotions: 'Ei tieliikennekelpoinen' (not roadworthy, often with very low prices), 'Pakettiauto' (van-registered), '**Korko alk. 1,99%**', 'Katsastettu 04/2026!'.
Fuel values seen: Bensiini, Diesel, 'Hybridi (bensiini/sähkö)'. Drive values seen: Etuveto, Neliveto, and Takaveto on a search card (fact-check 2026-10-17). Gearbox values seen: Automaatti, Manuaali.
The English UI translates labels and fixed values ('Petrol', 'Station wagon', 'Automatic') but leaves the variant text and 'Notes' in Finnish ('DSG-automaatti', '96 kW (130 hv)').
Boilerplate on every ad: Rekkari.fi history checks ('Hinta alkaen 2,90 €', 'Tarjoushinta -20 %') and the financing block. None of it is ad data.

Same network as Autotalli: Autotalli's ad page links to Nettiauto, Nettimoto, Nettivene, Nettikone, Nettikaravaani and Rekkari, and Nettiauto ad pages link to Alma Ajo account services (oma.almaajo.fi, tili.almaajo.fi). The earlier claim that Nettiauto login redirects to auth.nettix.fi could not be confirmed: no auth.nettix.fi link was in the ad-page HTML (fact-check 2026-10-17).
Plain HTTP clients get a Cloudflare challenge page (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...'). This supports reading pasted text rather than fetching URLs.

A whole-page copy also picks up other cars: the dealer's other ads ('BMW 530 / 9940 € / alk. 169,22 €/kk / Diesel 2011 340 000 km Takaveto') and 'SUOSITUT' cards ('Volvo 740 / 2 000 € / 1988'). Their prices, years and kilometres are not this car's. Dealer free text can also carry prices of add-on products ('Bilar-Turvalla - alkaen vain 14,90€/kk') (fact-check 2026-10-17).

notes: Ad pages are Finnish only. The HTML lists only a fi-FI language version, and no English switch was visible on the page, although the UI strings include 'In English'. The page config has 'featureFlags.enableEnglishLocale': false, and https://www.etuovi.com/en returns 404 (fact-check 2026-10-17).
Header: '<Type> | <layout>' / street, district, city / 'Hinta' + price / 'Koko' + area / 'Vuosi' + year, then the description.
Check: Myyntihinta + Velkaosuus = Velaton hinta. This held on all 3 ads (237 215,27 + 60 784,73 = 298 000,00).
Check: Hoitovastike + Pääomavastike (+ Erityisvastike + Tontin vuokravastike) = Yhtiövastike yhteensä (238,00 + 370,69 = 608,69).
When there is no debt, Velkaosuus is missing and Myyntihinta = Velaton hinta.
Agent and property-manager contacts appear under 'Kohdetta myy', 'Esittelijänä', 'Isännöitsijän yhteystiedot' and 'Tiedustelut'. They are personal data, so skip them.
Sale ads can say 'Huoneisto myydään vuokrattuna, vuokra 730 e/kk' (sold with a tenant). The rent there is free text, not a price.
Page boilerplate includes a home-insurance offer ('Löydä paras ja edullisin kotivakuutus kotiisi. Laske hinta'), Urakkamaailma renovation prices and broadband offers. None of it is ad data.

Etuovi and Vuokraovi run on the same platform (both pages carry '© Alma Media Oyj' and the same section names). The earlier claim that some ad ids appear on both sites is unconfirmed: etuovi.com/kohde/60499747 (a Vuokraovi id) and vuokraovi.com/kohde/59008973 (an Etuovi id) both returned 404 (fact-check 2026-10-17).

Page order: breadcrumb (Myytävät asunnot / city / district), header line, summary block, description, Perustiedot, Hinta, Vastikkeet, Muut maksut, Talon ja tontin tiedot, Tilat ja materiaalit, Tekniset tiedot.
The header price and the summary 'Velaton hinta' are the debt-free price. Search-engine snippets of the same ad can be out of date: 149 000 € in a snippet against 139 000 € on the page.
Check: Myyntihinta + Velkaosuus = Velaton hinta. It held on both ads, including a new build where the debt share was about 70 % of the price (144 835,95 + 330 164,05 = 475 000).
Check: Hoitovastike + Pääomavastike = Yhtiövastike yhteensä (365,40 + 1 741,51 = 2 106,91).

Right-of-occupancy flats (asumisoikeus) appear in searches with a low 'price' (one search snippet: 19 576 € with a 679,62 €/kk charge; unverified, the ad page was gone). That figure is a right-of-occupancy fee, not a purchase price.

Pages of removed ads return HTTP 410. Some say 'Tämä kohde on poistunut palvelustamme.'; others show a generic page ('Voi harmi, että Oikotie ei löytänyt perille.'). Both were seen on removed Turku rental ads (vuokra-asunnot/turku/24536424 and /24627773, fact-check 2026-10-17). Several ads found through search on the observation date had already been removed.
The agent's name is printed near the top of the ad. Skip it.

Search card: '<address>, <district>, <city> | 739 € / kk | 36,5 m² | Huoneita 2 | Kerros 1/4 | Kerrostalo, 2020'.

Deposits come in many forms: a number ('Vakuus 569 €'), months ('1 kk vuokra'), none with a Qasa contract (2 of 6 ads) or free text in the description (the sixth ad: 'vuokravakuus on 0 €'). On the 3 ads with a numeric Vakuus, the deposit was one month's rent each time (685/685, 819/819 and 569/569 €; fact-check 2026-10-17). Search snippets also showed 'Vakuus 1 540 €. Myös kk-maksullinen digivakuus mahdollinen', 'Vuokravakuus kahden kuukauden vuokra' and '(1300e)' (unverified, snippets only).
'Lisätietoa vuokra-ajasta: 12 kk' is a minimum or fixed term. It is not a deposit.

'Kotivakuutus vaaditaan' (home insurance required) appears in 'Muut ehdot' (1 of the 6 ads); another ad required it in the description ('Laaja kotivakuutus vastuuosineen vaaditaan') (fact-check 2026-10-17).
Descriptions often repeat the fees in free text: '-Vesimaksu 27e/kk/henkilö', '-Autopaikka 35e/kk', '-Irtisanomisaika 1kk'.
Ads are often removed within weeks (HTTP 410), so ads found through search engines are frequently gone.
The landlord's name or company appears under 'Kohdetta vuokraa'. Skip it.

notes: Vuokraovi has an English UI under /en/item/<id>. It translates labels and fixed values but leaves free text in Finnish (Vakuus '1 kk:n kokonaisvuokra', Vuokranmaksupäivä 'Kuukauden 2. päivä', and the description).
In the English UI 'Huoneita: Kaksio' becomes 'Number of rooms: 1 bedroom', so rooms = bedrooms + 1. Only Kaksio was seen; other room words are assumed to follow the same rule.
The English page title says 'For sale Block of flats 1 bedroom - …' on a rental ad, so do not use the page title to decide whether an ad is a sale or a rental.
The header shows '840 €/kk' with no spaces; the details show '840 € / kk'.
On one ad 'Vuokra 1 020 € / kk' had a thousands separator but 'Vakuus 1020 €' did not.

Ad pages carry a home-insurance price widget. Its footnote says the estimate is for If's broad home insurance ('laaja kotivakuutus') with a 250 € deductible, for flats in blocks of flats and terraced houses. The figures seen were 11 €/kk for 42,5 m² and 17 €/kk for 80 m². These are the site's own estimates (observed 2026-10-17); a reader must not take them for rent or fees. Re-checked: the footnote reads '*Hinta on laskettu Ifin laajalle kotivakuutukselle 250€ omavastuulla kerros-ja rivitaloasuntoihin.' (EN: '*The price is calculated for If's comprehensive home insurance with a deductible of €250 for apartment and terraced houses.'), 11 €/kk on /kohde/ct8278 and 17 €/kk on /kohde/60499747 (fact-check 2026-10-17).
Shares a platform with Etuovi (both pages carry '© Alma Media Oyj'). The claim that some ad ids appear on both sites is unconfirmed (two cross-checks returned 404, fact-check 2026-10-17).
The landlord's name appears next to 'Yksityinen vuokranantaja'. Skip it.
